Hi Lena,

Thanks again for your time today — really appreciated the candid conversation and the chance to walk through Redwood’s dedicated inference options. Quick recap from my side and three proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap:
- Use case: inference for search ranking + personalization (low tail latency, 5–10M queries/day expected)
- Key success criteria: P99 latency <200ms, predictable monthly unit cost, SOC2 compliance for audit
- Pilot scope: 2 models, dev->prod in 6–8 weeks if we have security/procurement alignment

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Economic buyer: could you confirm the economic buyer for this initiative? We discussed CTO sponsorship but wanted to confirm who owns budget and approval (name + email).
2) Procurement/legal: please confirm the procurement contact to route commercial/POs and any standard terms.
3) Proposed next call: 30-min intro with the economic buyer + procurement to align on pricing and procurement timeline.

I’ve attached a short mutual action plan to make it easy to share internally — it outlines milestones, expected artifacts (SOW, security questionnaire), and a suggested timeline. [Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_Acme_v1.pdf (pdf)]

Proposed availability next week: Tue/Wed 10–12 PDT or Thu 14–16 PDT. If you prefer, I can introduce the economic buyer looped into email.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Hi Markus — nice to meet you via email, and thanks Lena for the intro.

I’m Marissa, the account lead on Redwood Inference. We had a short demo with Lena and the product team yesterday — high-level points:
- Use case: scalable LLM inference for search ranking and personalization (expected 5–10M queries/day)
- Goals: P99 latency <200ms, SOC2 evidence for security, predictable unit economics
- Timeline: pilot (2 models) in ~6–8 weeks pending security review and procurement

Quick asks so we can align next week: 
1) Confirm you as the economic buyer/sponsor for the initiative. If not, who should we engage (name + email)?
2) Confirm the budget owner / finance contact (Lena suggested Amira Khan — is that correct?).
3) Any procurement or legal constraints we should know about up front (standard redlines, PO timelines)?

We’re happy to provide a concise SOW + SOC2 evidence pack and a pricing summary. To keep things actionable I’ve attached a short pricing summary and the mutual action plan. A suggested agenda for a 30-min call: 1) technical fit (Aditya & Dev), 2) commercial/terms (Marissa), 3) procurement next steps.

Proposed slots (PDT): Tue 3/9 10:30–11:00, Wed 3/10 11:00–11:30, Thu 3/11 14:00–14:30. If those don’t work, tell me two windows that do and I’ll send a calendar invite.
